author: MandaloreGaming
description:
The BioShock Review looks back at the first person shooter underwater spiritual follow-up to System Shock 2, along with why BioShock Remastered isn't so much of a remaster and more of a compression experience. Come on down to Andrew Ryan's Rapture below the sea that isn't too far away from the original intention of Epcot.
